title: withcoral/coral
claim: withcoral/coral — One SQL interface over APIs, files, and live sources — built for agents.
why_good: One SQL interface over APIs, files and live sources, built for agents — a clean way to give agents reliable, typed data access instead of ad-hoc tools.
value: Usage-based data-gateway for agent builders: query/route/govern data across sources; upsell managed connectors + enterprise.
risk: Crowded data-virtualization space (Trino, Steampipe); 'for agents' must translate into a real distribution edge.
pick_reason: Coral provides a clear product that simplifies data access for agents, which can be monetized through subscriptions or licensing.

zh.claim: withcoral/coral —— 面向 agent 的统一 SQL 接口,覆盖 API、文件与实时数据源。
zh.why_good: 用一个 SQL 接口统管 API/文件/实时源,为 agent 而建——给 agent 可靠、带类型的数据访问,而非临时拼工具。
zh.value: 给 agent 开发者做按量数据网关:跨源查询/路由/治理,upsell 托管连接器 + 企业版。
zh.risk: 数据虚拟化很挤(Trino、Steampipe);"为 agent"必须真的转化成分发优势。
zh.hook: 用一个 SQL 接口统管 API、文件与实时源——为 agent 打造的可靠数据访问。

hook: One SQL interface over APIs, files and live sources — reliable data access, built for agents.
